plan.title: Warmup at 60 BPM
plan.goal: Warm up the fingers and strumming hand while settling into a steady 60 BPM pulse, using one downstroke on every beat.
tips: Count 1-2-3-4 aloud and keep each downstroke relaxed and even.
Start with muted strings or an open-string pattern before adding chord shapes.

plan.title: Practise the Am to C chord change
plan.goal: Practise changing between Am and C at 60 BPM, playing one downstroke on every beat and aiming for smooth, timely chord changes.
tips: Use four beats on Am, then four beats on C, keeping the strumming hand moving even during the change.
Move the fingers that differ between the chords first and keep shared fingers anchored where possible.

plan.title: Review and consolidate
plan.goal: Review the Am and C change at 60 BPM with one downstroke on every beat, reinforcing steady timing and clean chord shapes.
tips: Repeat short rounds of Am to C and pause between rounds to reset finger placement.
Finish with a continuous run at 60 BPM, prioritising an unbroken beat over stopping to correct a chord.

target.title: Khởi động ở 60 BPM
target.goal: Khởi động các ngón tay và tay gảy trong khi ổn định theo nhịp đều 60 BPM, dùng một lần gảy xuống ở mỗi phách.
tips: Đếm 1-2-3-4 thành tiếng và giữ mỗi lần gảy xuống thả lỏng và đều.
Bắt đầu với dây bịt hoặc mẫu dây buông trước khi thêm các thế bấm hợp âm.
